zh: 当前版本为 {{installedVersion}}，源码管理需要 Git {{minimumVersion}} 或更高版本。
en: The installed version is {{installedVersion}}. Source control requires Git {{minimumVersion}} or later.

zh: 无法识别 Git 版本
en: Git version could not be identified

zh: 当前 Git 无法可靠识别，请修复或重新安装 Git 后重试。
en: The installed Git could not be identified reliably. Repair or reinstall Git and try again.

zh: Git 仓库还没有首次提交
en: The repository has no initial commit

zh: 可以先在“更改”中选择文件、暂存并创建首次提交。
en: Select files in Changes, stage them, and create the initial commit.

zh: 当前 Git 不支持 Worktree
en: This Git version does not support worktrees

zh: 请更新系统 Git 后重新检测。
en: Update system Git and check again.

zh: 仓库元数据无法读取，请检查目录权限或 Git 状态后重试。
en: Repository metadata could not be read. Check directory permissions or Git state and try again.

zh: 当前工作空间正由 {{operation}} 使用
en: This workspace is in use by {{operation}}

zh: 正在聚合所选提交的文件变化…
en: Aggregating file changes from the selected commits…

zh: 选择提交后在这里查看变更文件
en: Select a commit to inspect its changed files

zh: 展示当前仍包含该提交的引用，以及它相对当前分支的可验证路径。
en: Shows refs that currently contain this commit and its verifiable path relative to the current branch.

zh: 包含该提交的分支与标签
当前没有引用包含该提交
en: No current ref contains this commit

zh: 首次进入主线的 Merge 提交
通过 Merge 进入主线

en: Not yet contained by the current branch

zh: 移除远端已删除的分支记录
en: Remove records for branches deleted on the remote

zh: 不会删除本地分支或工作区文件。
en: Local branches and working-tree files are not deleted.
Switch to the new branch after creation

zh: 将只暂存当前所有冲突文件并继续。请先确认冲突内容已经正确处理；普通未冲突改动不会被暂存。
en: Only the current conflicted files will be staged before continuing. Confirm their contents are correct; ordinary non-conflict changes will not be staged.

zh: Git 将中止当前 {{operation}} 并尽可能恢复到操作开始前的状态。
en: Git will abort the current {{operation}} and attempt to restore the state from before it began.

zh: 当前 Commit {{sha}} {{subject}} 的改动将不会应用，Rebase 会继续处理下一个 Commit。
en: Changes from commit {{sha}} {{subject}} will not be applied. Rebase will continue with the next commit.

zh: 获取远程引用，不修改当前工作区。
en: Fetch remote refs without modifying the working tree.

zh: 从当前 upstream 拉取并按所选策略整合。
en: Pull from the current upstream using the selected strategy.

zh: 推送当前分支；首次推送会设置 upstream。
en: Push the current branch and set upstream on its first push.

zh: 从指定起点创建本地分支。
en: Create a local branch from the selected start point.

zh: 将 {{target}} 重命名为新名称。
仅删除已经合并的本地分支 {{target}}。
en: Delete local branch {{target}} only if it is already merged.

zh: 在指定提交上创建本地标签。
en: Create a local tag on the selected commit.

zh: 删除本地标签 {{target}}，不会删除远程标签。
en: Delete local tag {{target}} without deleting its remote copy.

zh: 将本地标签 {{target}} 显式推送到远程。
en: Explicitly push local tag {{target}} to a remote.

zh: 在指定路径创建关联工作区。
en: Create a linked worktree at the selected path.

zh: 从仓库登记中删除此 Worktree 及其工作目录。不会删除关联分支；存在未提交或未跟踪更改时不会强制删除。
en: Remove this worktree registration and working directory. Its branch is preserved, and a worktree with uncommitted or untracked changes is never force-removed.

zh: 保存当前更改，不会自动包含未跟踪文件。
en: Save current changes; untracked files are excluded by default.

zh: 应用 {{target}} 并保留该 Stash。
en: Apply {{target}} and preserve the stash entry.

zh: GitHub 能力检测将在此处显示
en: GitHub capability detection will appear here

zh: GitHub CLI 状态检测失败
安装后可在此查看 Pull Request 和 Issue；本地 Git 功能不受影响。
en: Install it to view pull requests and issues here. Local Git features remain available.

zh: 授权将在浏览器中完成，应用不会读取或保存 GitHub token。
en: Authorization completes in your browser. The app never reads or stores your GitHub token.

zh: 无法确定 GitHub 仓库
en: GitHub repository could not be resolved

zh: 请检查当前分支 upstream 或 origin 是否指向 GitHub 仓库。
en: Check that the current branch upstream or origin points to a GitHub repository.

zh: 正在加载 Pull Request 详情…
选择比较分支，确认标题和正文后创建。
en: Choose the comparison branches, then review the title and body.
Branch {{head}} has not been published to {{remote}}.

zh: 这些分支已有打开的 Pull Request #{{number}}。
en: These branches already have open pull request #{{number}}.

zh: 没有可查看的变更文件
系统浅色或深色变化时自动切换主题。
en: Automatically switch when your system changes light or dark mode.

zh: 同一设计风格内选择跟随系统、浅色或深色。
en: Choose system, light, or dark within the same design style.

zh: 完整效果保留主题材质，性能优先会降低模糊与阴影开销。
en: Full preserves the material; Performance reduces blur and shadow cost.

zh: 使用当前主题定义的有序字体回退。
en: Use the ordered font fallback defined by the current theme.

zh: 应用内置，作为代码编辑与差异查看的稳定默认字体。
en: Bundled for consistent code editing and diff rendering.

zh: 侧栏、设置、聊天正文和普通 Markdown。
en: Sidebar, settings, chat prose, and regular Markdown.

zh: 文件查看与编辑、运行产物及所有差异视图。
en: File viewing and editing, run artifacts, and all diff views.

zh: 调整应用界面使用的基准字号。
en: Adjust the base font size used across the app interface.

zh: 调整 CodeMirror 文件与差异视图中的字号。
en: Adjust text in CodeMirror file and diff views.

zh: 已载入 {{count}} 个本机字体；越靠前优先级越高。
en: {{count}} local fonts loaded. Earlier fonts have higher priority.

zh: 地址栏输入的内容不是网址时，用所选搜索引擎搜索。
en: Use the selected search engine when the address bar input is not a URL.

zh: 在内置浏览器中打开 localhost
en: Open localhost in the built-in browser

zh: 对话和文档里的本机服务地址会在内置浏览器打开。关闭后改用系统浏览器。
en: Localhost addresses in chats and documents open in the built-in browser. When off, they open in the system browser.

zh: 在内置浏览器中打开网站
en: Open websites in the built-in browser

zh: 对话和文档里的普通网站会在内置浏览器打开。关闭后改用系统浏览器。
en: Websites in chats and documents open in the built-in browser. When off, they open in the system browser.

zh: 授权、接收账号与配置管理
将停用连接并从系统凭据存储中删除 secret。待投递消息也会停止发送。
en: This disables the connection, removes its secret from the OS credential store, and stops pending deliveries.

zh: 使用手机企业微信扫码并确认授权。
en: Scan with the WeCom mobile app and confirm authorization.

zh: 尚未接入企业微信。接入后可设置远程干预与通知。
en: WeCom is not connected. Connect it to configure remote intervention and notifications.

zh: 请使用企业微信扫码并确认授权
en: Scan with WeCom and confirm authorization

zh: 二维码将在 {{countdown}} 后过期
授权完成，等待绑定接收账号
请在企业微信中给机器人发送一条消息，以完成一对一私聊绑定。
en: Send the bot a message in WeCom to finish binding the private chat.

zh: 扫码授权后，通过一对一私聊绑定接收账号。
en: Authorize by QR code, then bind a recipient through a private chat.

zh: 请在企业微信中给机器人发送一条消息。持久绑定完成后即可接收干预。
en: Send the bot a message in WeCom. Remote intervention becomes available after the binding is persisted.

zh: 连接建立后会自动恢复远程干预。
en: Remote intervention resumes automatically when the connection is ready.

zh: 系统正在使用有界退避重试，无需重复操作。
en: The bounded retry policy is active. No repeated action is needed.

zh: 自动恢复无法继续，请重新连接。
en: Automatic recovery cannot continue. Reconnect to try again.

zh: 远程干预和已启用的通知会发送到已绑定私聊。
en: Remote interventions and enabled notifications are sent to the bound private chat.

zh: 通知偏好会保留，重新启用后继续生效。
en: Notification preferences are preserved and resume when enabled.

zh: 当前凭据不可用，请重新扫码授权。
en: The current credentials are unavailable. Authorize the bot again.

zh: 机器人正在其他客户端连接
请先关闭其他客户端，再发起一次真实重连。
en: Close the other client, then start one real reconnect attempt.

zh: 将清除当前一对一私聊绑定，但保留机器人授权、启用状态和通知偏好。之后请使用新账号给机器人发送消息。
en: This clears the current private-chat binding while preserving bot authorization, enabled state, and notification preferences. Then message the bot from the new account.

zh: 请填写有效的公开标识。

en: Credentials are required before enabling this channel.

zh: 无法访问系统凭据存储。
en: The OS credential store is unavailable.

zh: 平台请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
en: The platform is rate limiting requests. Try again later.

zh: 无法连接 IM 平台。
平台返回了无法识别的响应。
en: The platform returned an unrecognized response.

zh: 请先与机器人建立一对一私聊。
en: Start a private chat with the bot first.

zh: 当前操作用户不是已授权用户。
en: The current user is not the authorized user.

zh: 当前会话不是已绑定私聊。
en: This is not the bound private chat.

zh: 当前平台能力不支持此操作。
en: The platform does not support this operation.

zh: 无法访问 IM 投递存储。
en: The IM delivery store is unavailable.

zh: 该机器人已在其他客户端连接，请关闭另一处连接后重试。
en: This bot is connected by another client. Close the other connection and try again.

zh: 二维码已过期，请重新生成。
en: The QR code expired. Generate a new one.

zh: 扫码授权已超时，请重新生成。
en: QR authorization timed out. Generate a new code.

zh: 暂时无法连接企业微信授权服务。
en: The WeCom authorization service is temporarily unreachable.

zh: 企业微信授权响应无效，请重新生成。
en: The WeCom authorization response was invalid. Generate a new code.

zh: 扫码会话无效，请重新打开。
en: The QR session is invalid. Reopen it.
QR authorization is already in progress.

zh: 连接状态已更新，请根据最新状态重试。
en: The connection state changed. Retry from the latest state.
The IM runtime is not ready.

zh: 配置已删除，本地清理将在后台自动重试。
en: The configuration was deleted. Local cleanup will retry in the background.

zh: 展示在 Agent 回复旁。
拖动图片调整位置，并使用缩放控制取景范围。
en: Drag the image to position it and use zoom to adjust the framing.
Avatar processing failed. Please try again.

zh: 自定义壁纸会覆盖主题包壁纸，并随客户端尺寸自适应。
en: A custom wallpaper overrides the theme wallpaper and adapts to the client size.
The current theme has no wallpaper

zh: 如果打开，优先本地查找 Claude，可能会有兼容性问题，如果关闭，使用 SDK 携带的 Claude
en: If enabled, prioritizes the locally installed Claude executable. May have compatibility issues. If disabled, uses the Claude bundled with the SDK.

zh: 未找到本地 Claude，将使用 SDK 内置版本
en: Local Claude not found, using SDK bundled version

zh: 开启后 runtime.log 会记录 DEBUG 级别日志，关闭后仅记录常规信息级日志。
en: When enabled, runtime.log records DEBUG-level diagnostics. When disabled, it only records normal INFO-level runtime logs.

zh: 开启后，客户端会按应用与任务生命周期事件上报心跳和节点执行指标到配置的服务器。
en: When enabled, the client reports heartbeat and node execution metrics from application and task lifecycle events.
Leave empty to use built-in URL

zh: 可前往 设置 → 高级 → 更新 查看并安装。
en: Go to Settings → Advanced → Updates to review and install it.

zh: 检测到新的客户端版本。请前往 设置 → 高级 → 更新 完成下载和安装。
en: A new client version has been detected. Go to Settings → Advanced → Updates to download and install it.

zh: 附件保存失败，请重新选择后再发送
en: Could not save attachments. Choose them again before sending.

zh: AUTO 模式需要选择 Agent
en: Agent is required for AUTO mode

zh: Direct 模式需要选择 Agent
en: Agent is required for Direct mode

zh: 所选 Direct Agent 尚未配置
en: Selected Direct Agent is not configured

zh: 所选 Direct Agent 当前不可用
所选模型不受当前 Direct Agent 支持
en: Selected model is not supported by this Direct Agent

zh: 所选权限模式不受当前 Direct Agent 支持
en: Selected permission mode is not supported by this Direct Agent

zh: 所选 Agent 尚未配置
所选模型不受当前 Agent 支持
en: Selected model is not supported by this Agent

zh: 所选权限模式不受当前 Agent 支持
en: Selected permission mode is not supported by this Agent

zh: 所选工作流模板不存在
附件数量不能超过 10 个
单个附件不能超过 25 MB
附件总大小不能超过 100 MB
en: Total attachment size cannot exceed 100 MB

zh: 置顶会话会显示在这里
会话“{{title}}”将从 ~/.gold-band 对应 task 目录移除，此操作不可撤销。若系统支持，将优先移入回收站。是否继续？
en: Conversation “{{title}}” will be removed from its task directory under ~/.gold-band. This cannot be undone. When supported, it will be moved to the recycle bin first. Continue?

zh: 这会将该工作空间从侧栏中移除。磁盘上的文件和历史会话不会被删除。
en: This removes the workspace from the sidebar. Files on disk and conversation history will not be deleted.

zh: 工作空间加载失败，点击重试
en: Workspace loading failed. Click to retry

zh: 会话加载失败，点击重试
en: Conversation loading failed. Click to retry

zh: 置顶会话加载失败，点击重试
en: Pinned conversations failed to load. Click to retry

zh: 运行历史加载失败，点击重试
en: Run history failed to load. Click to retry

zh: 连接后可在此查看并领取 Multica 需求。
en: Connect to view and claim Multica requirements.

zh: 服务端暂无可绑定的工作空间，请先在 multica Web 创建工作空间。
en: No bindable workspaces on the server yet. Create one in multica Web first.

zh: 所有远程工作空间均已绑定。
en: All remote workspaces are already bound.

zh: 请先添加本地工作空间，再执行需求
en: Add a local workspace before running a requirement

zh: 当前版本为 {{installedVersion}}，分支功能需要 Git {{minimumVersion}} 或更高版本。
en: The installed version is {{installedVersion}}. Branch features require Git {{minimumVersion}} or later.

zh: 已在其他 Worktree 中检出

en: Create and check out new branch…
Create and check out a new branch

zh: 从 {{branch}} 创建新分支，并将当前工作区切换到该分支。
en: Create a branch from {{branch}} and switch the current workspace to it.

zh: Git 正在执行其他写操作，暂时不能切换分支。
en: Another Git write is running. Branch switching is temporarily unavailable.

zh: {{operation}} 正在进行，完成或中止后才能切换分支。
en: A {{operation}} is in progress. Complete or abort it before switching branches.

zh: 早上好，今天想一起做点什么？
en: Good morning. What shall we work on?

zh: 上午好，今天想一起做点什么？
en: Good morning. What shall we work on?

zh: 中午好，今天想一起做点什么？
en: Good afternoon. What shall we work on?

zh: 下午好，今天想一起做点什么？
en: Good afternoon. What shall we work on?

zh: 晚上好，今天想一起做点什么？
en: Good evening. What shall we work on?

zh: 夜深了，想一起做点什么？
en: It's late. What shall we work on?

zh: 创建副本，以便并行工作
en: Create a copy for parallel work

zh: 请先在 Agent 管理中添加 Agent
en: Add an agent in Agent Management first

zh: 首次使用需要先配置运行模式，包括 Agent 和工作流设置。
en: Configure your run mode settings including agent and workflow preferences before getting started.

zh: 停止当前 Run 并重跑？
当前 Run 仍在运行中，重跑会先停止当前 Run，然后创建一个新的 Run。历史 Run 会保留。
en: The current run is still active. Rerunning will stop it first, then create a new run. Run history is preserved.

zh: 工作流无效，请修复后再试
当前会话已暂停，可继续运行
en: Current session is paused and can continue

zh: 当前会话运行失败，请查看错误原因
en: The current session failed. Review the reason.

zh: 当前会话已终止，请查看错误原因
en: The current session was stopped. Review the reason.

zh: 因错误阻塞，处理后可继续
en: Error blocked. Resolve it and continue.

zh: 当前运行因错误阻塞，请查看错误原因
en: The current run is blocked by an error. Review the reason.

zh: 当前选择的模型不支持思考强度，请清除思考强度或更换模型后重试
en: The selected model does not support reasoning effort. Clear the reasoning effort or switch models, then retry.

zh: 思考强度 {{value}} 不可用，可选：{{values}}
配置项 {{configId}} 不支持所选值 {{value}}，可选：{{values}}
en: Config option {{configId}} does not support value {{value}}. Available: {{values}}

zh: 配置项 {{configId}} 不支持所选值 {{value}}，请调整后重试
en: Config option {{configId}} does not support value {{value}}. Adjust it and retry.

zh: 无法创建新工作树，请检查当前仓库的工作树状态后重试
en: Unable to create a new worktree. Check the repository worktree state and try again.

zh: 当前会话由 runtime 运行中，暂不可输入
en: This session is being controlled by the runtime, so input is temporarily unavailable

zh: 当前会话已停止，你可以输入任何内容继续运行
en: This session has stopped. You can enter any message to continue the run

zh: 当前版本为 {{installedVersion}}，Gold Band 的 Git 功能需要 Git {{minimumVersion}} 或更高版本。
en: The installed version is {{installedVersion}}. Gold Band Git features require Git {{minimumVersion}} or later.

zh: Gold Band 无法识别当前 Git 版本。请修复或重新安装 Git 后重新检测。
en: Gold Band could not identify the installed Git version. Repair or reinstall Git, then check again.

zh: 当前文件夹还不是 Git 仓库
en: This folder is not a Git repository

zh: Git 仓库需要首次提交
en: An initial Git commit is required

zh: 初始化仓库后还需要在 Git 工作区完成首次提交，Gold Band 不会自动暂存或提交整个目录。
en: After initialization, create the first commit in the Git workspace. Gold Band will not stage or commit the whole folder automatically.

zh: 请在右侧 Git 工作区完成首次提交。Gold Band 不会替你选择或提交文件。
en: Create the first commit in the Git workspace. Gold Band will not choose or commit files for you.

zh: 安装 Git 并重新检测后即可使用 Auto 模式。你也可以选择其他不包含 AI-DYNAMIC 的工作流。
en: Install Git and check again to use Auto mode, or choose a workflow without AI-DYNAMIC.

zh: 此工作流包含 AI-DYNAMIC，需要 Git、有效 HEAD 和 worktree 能力才能运行。
en: This workflow contains AI-DYNAMIC and requires Git, a valid HEAD, and worktree support.

zh: 创建工作树需要 Git、有效 HEAD 和 worktree 能力。完成配置后重新检测即可选择新工作树。
en: Creating a worktree requires Git, a valid HEAD, and worktree support. Check again after the repository is ready.

zh: 已停止当前 Run 并创建新 Run
en: Stopped current run and created new run
